note: Exploratory interface smoke test on one benchmark task. It is not part of the pilot matrix and must not be pooled with pilot results.

attempts.defect: The connector did not forward the harness action schema, so the model guessed an unsupported format ({action, length}) and repeated it until the call limit.

After schema forwarding, the schema itself was ambiguous: a top-level actions array, nested fields objects and an allowlist field inside submit. The model copied those shapes literally and was rejected.

attempts.note: The model concatenated two actions on calls 0 and 1 and recovered after the rejection included the parser error. It then read, submitted one command batch, received the PASS certificate, and finished.

defects_found_and_fixed: luna-connector now appends the harness action schema to the provider instructions of every call, so all arms see their permitted actions.
The action schema no longer has a top-level actions wrapper, no nested fields objects, and no allowlist field inside submit; it contains a flat allowed_actions catalog and flat parseable examples.
Malformed-action feedback now includes the bounded parser error, allowing recovery instead of blind repetition.
controls_affected: The schema and malformed-feedback changes apply identically to all four arms. They change the interface text, so any earlier interface-failure data is not comparable and was not used.
not_measured: Per-message feedback and verification token attribution remains null.
Monetary cost remains null; pricing is deferred.
The three smoke attempts consumed ChatGPT Plus quota and are not a statistical sample.
